attributes.name: zlmaxsize
attributes.digest: Maximum List Length
attributes.description: Sets the maximum list length for all modes of operation. This is the equivalent to using an argument to the object, but allows the list length to be changed dynamically. The default list length is 256, and the maximum list length limit is 32,767.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Allows for the recognition of lists that begin with symbols.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Immediately outputs current list.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: Adds to grouped listIn right inlet: Sets group size
